messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about travel, offsites, and workspace ops. I pulled answers together here, please ask clarifying q's and we'll update the doc: https://redwood.company/confluence/hybrid-travel.

Tom (Eng): Thanks! Quick one — is there a per-person travel allowance for regional offsites or do teams just expense?

Aisha (People Ops): For company-organized offsites we cover travel + lodging centrally and publish a per-person meal stipend. For team-run offsites, teams can use the Team Events budget; if you want company reimbursement instead, submit 1) event brief and 2) estimated cost to people-ops@redwood. We have an expense code: EXP-OFFSITE-TEAM.

Lee (Sales): If I bring customer demos to a city and expense travel, does that fall under the same Team Events budget or is it sales travel?

Aisha (People Ops): Customer-facing travel should use the Sales/Travel budget (EXP-TRVL-SALES). If it's mixed (team offsite + customer meeting) include a short note on the expense form and we’ll split per policy.

Emma (Design): Desk sharing — can contractors reserve desks in hub offices for a day? I couldn't find the rule in the doc.

Aisha (People Ops): Contractors can get day-passes for hub access but need pre-approval from the hiring manager and a sponsor in that office. Submit requests via the Workspace app > Guest Access and mark "Contractor - day pass". Contractors do not automatically get permanent desk assignments.

Tom (Eng): What's the policy for requesting dedicated meeting rooms during busy weeks (e.g., demo week)? 

Aisha (People Ops): Book rooms via Calendar and the workspace booking tool. For multi-day block bookings for a team offsite, send a request to workspace@redwood with dates and estimated headcount; Ops will confirm within 2 business days.

Raj (Manager): Is there guidance for international travel (visa support / per diem) — we have folks traveling to APAC next quarter.

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — for international trips we provide visa-letter support and a per diem based on country. Start by submitting the Travel Authorization in Concur (link in the doc). For multi-week assignments, talk to your manager + people-ops early so we can open payroll/immigration tracks.

Ops-bot: Reminder: workspace capacity limits in SF hub this week are 75% due to events. Please stagger bookings. :warning:

Emma (Design): Thanks! One more — are there guidelines for event swag shipping to an offsite location? Last time a bunch of boxes arrived with no one there to receive them.

Aisha (People Ops): Good call — new guideline: shipments to host locations must be scheduled to arrive no earlier than 48 hours before the event and addressed to a named attendee. For larger shipments contact workplace-logistics@redwood so we can coordinate receiving and storage.

Tom (Eng): Appreciate the quick answers. Can we add an FAQ entry about travel approvals for managers? That cut down back-and-forth.

Aisha (People Ops): Will do — I'll add a short manager checklist to the Confluence page and ping this thread when it's live. Thanks for the questions! :party_parrot:
